content.title: Is Your Favorite Show Coming Back or Canceled? See Our Fall TV 2026–2027 Guide
content.text: With the midseason schedule already on the air, ABC, CBS, FOX, and NBC are starting to solidify their lineups for the 2026-27 broadcast season. This year, there have been several early pickups for returning TV shows that will be back on the schedule, especially from CBS and ABC, but there have also been notifications of cancelations and new shows additions, which we have compiled into this listings schedule to make it easy for you to keep track. Below is Parade’s annual guide to what’s returning, what’s canceled and what’s new at the broadcast networks.
